title: Watch Duty: Spider Season
summary: Spiders are nesting near the fields. The farmers won't go out after dark.

dialogue.intro: The farmers won't go out after dark. Spiders, big ones, in the hedges.
offer: Six. That should scare the rest off.
Bring a torch. They hate the light, and so do I, out there.
dialogue.return: The hedges still rustle at night.
dialogue.reward: The farmers went out last night and came back. Thank you.
dialogue.done: Not a spider in the hedges since.
